keyFindings.description: AGENTS.md:128 (the 'Run a database, broker or server the work needs' row, the row clause 2 already edits) still names the gate as "`kubectl auth can-i create jobs`, `create services` and `get services` are the gate": the form without -n that the page now says a role cannot trust. AGENTS.md is auto-loaded into every session in this repository, so it is the copy most agents copy. The architect ruled it in scope (Envoy reply e33544ba, and the pull-request comment of 09:27:48Z): the row's middle sentence becomes "`kubectl -n <namespace> auth can-i create jobs`, `create services` and `get services` are the gate", nothing else in the row changes; the check script must allow that one edit; the PR body says the page and the row were corrected together and why the row matters more.

roundOneFinding: Fixed at ce9ec359dbc7: the three gate commands carry -n <namespace> (docs/kubernetes.md:2671-2673), and the paragraph at 2699-2709 replaces 'no command here passes -n' with the measured mechanism (POD_NAMESPACE, else the projected namespace file, else default; client-go's in-cluster Namespace()), consistent with this reviewer's own 09:17Z measurement (bare yes x3, -n legion no x3). The five-sentence paragraph is accepted per the architect's ruling.
